episodes.title: Koniec niewinności
episodes.summary: In 1994, a summer camp reels from a brutal crime. Twenty-five years later, the police seek prosecutor Paweł Kopiński's help identifying a murder victim.

episodes.title: Kłamstwa
episodes.summary: A student's essay spooks Laura, and terrifying memories of the woods come rushing back. Paweł presses Inspector Jork to speak with Artur's parents.

episodes.title: Nic nie wiesz
episodes.summary: Paweł and Laura reunite. In 1994, Kamila's disappearance drives Paweł's family apart, while the Goldsztajns endure anti-Semitic harassment.

episodes.title: Czego oczy nie widzą
episodes.summary: In 2019, workers unearth human remains near the camp. In 1994, the police turn their attention to Paweł — who pursues his own hunch about the killer.

episodes.title: Twoja siostra nie żyje
episodes.summary: Determined to uncover what happened to Kamila, Paweł confronts a face from his past — and a puzzling claim sets his investigation on a new path.

episodes.title: Długa droga do domu
episodes.summary: Paweł makes a sacrifice for his family and finally learns the whole truth about that night in the woods.
